content_sections.heading: About UPSTDC
content_sections.text: Uttar Pradesh State Tourism Development Corporation Limited is a state corporation based at Rajarshi Purushottam Das Tandon Paryatan Bhawan, C-13, Vipin Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow. The corporation runs construction projects in almost all districts of Uttar Pradesh. These engineers will be attached to its technical cell (तकनीकी सेल).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only on the prescribed application form (Application Proforma). The form is attached to the notice. It can also be obtained free of cost from the corporation's office at Paryatan Bhawan, or downloaded from the corporation's website upstdc.co.in. Get the prescribed Application Proforma from the Paryatan Bhawan office or from upstdc.co.in. Fill in the form for the post on deputation. You may apply only for the post you currently hold in your parent department. Affix a self-attested recent passport size photograph and attach all the enclosures listed below. Forward the form through proper channel of your parent department. Send the duly filled form to: Managing Director, U.P. State Tourism Development Corporation, C-13, Vipin Khand, Gomtinagar, Lucknow. Send it by registered post or speed post, or submit it in person at the office, within the time limit. The date for submission is 31 December 2026. The form asks for: the post applied for, name in block letters, date of birth, father's name, contact number, a valid email ID, correspondence and permanent addresses, and whether the applicant is SC/ST/OBC/PwD. It also asks for educational qualifications with board or university, year, percentage or grade, duration and main subjects. You must give work experience in chronological order, latest first, with organisation, post, period, pay scale and nature of duties. You must also give the present department, parent department, present post, present total monthly emoluments and date of retirement. There is space for any additional information on your suitability. The form ends with a declaration and signature. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UPSTDC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 posts on deputation: 3 Assistant Engineer (Civil) and 8 Junior Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The date for submission of applications is 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these UPSTDC deputation posts?
faq.answer: Engineers working in government departments, undertakings, authorities or corporations of the Uttar Pradesh State Government or the Central Government can apply. Each applicant may apply only for the post held in the parent department.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years for both posts. Age is counted on the last date for submission of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for Assistant Engineer and Junior Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: Assistant Engineer (Civil) gets Pay Band-3 (15000-39100, Grade Pay 5400), equivalent to Pay Level-10 of the 7th pay scale. Junior Engineer (Civil) gets Pay Band-2 (9300-34800, Grade Pay 4200), equivalent to Pay Level-6.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form and forward it through proper channel of your parent department. Send it with all enclosures to the Managing Director, U.P. State Tourism Development Corporation, C-13, Vipin Khand, Gomtinagar, Lucknow, by registered post or speed post, or submit it in person.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The form is free at the corporation's Paryatan Bhawan office. It can also be downloaded from upstdc.co.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by personal interview. The interview date and applicants' names will be published on upstdc.co.in.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation?
faq.answer: The deputation is for 3 years. The competent authority may extend it up to 5 years if needed and if the officer is found suitable.

faq.question: Q10. Where will selected engineers be posted?
faq.answer: They may be posted at the headquarters or in the field, as the department requires. The corporation's construction projects are in almost all districts of Uttar Pradesh.
